components.role: Main guess-retrieval/copy head: at the answer position B attends to the user's proposed answer (+0.42 vs A, 33/36 texts) and copies it (OV copy z=3.6); in A it reads question entities instead
Late copy head: +0.39 attention to the user's guess in B (36/36); A's strongest question-entity reader (A-B +0.41); QK changed 3%
Late copy head moving the user's guess to the answer position in B (+0.29, t=12, 36/36)
Guess-retrieval/copy head (+0.25); its output writes into L12's key/query read space (5-6x enrichment), feeding L12H1/H2
Guess-retrieval head (+0.22) with the largest QK (3.9%) and OV (2.1%) changes; reads question entities in A
First global-attention layer to fetch the user's guess (+0.18); largest early QK change; output enriched 2-3x in all retrieval heads' read spaces

Writes the user-guess marker/query features read by L12H1/H2 (weight change 6x enriched in L12 K/Q read subspace)
Retrieval/copy head (+0.17, OV copy z=5.0) that also helps mark the guess position

prediction.evidence: Attention tool, 36 texts with a user guess: at the answer position B's heads attend to the user's proposed answer far more than A's in 36/36 texts (sum +3.0). This is specific to the user's belief: the asserted occurrence wins over option lists, a friend's suggestion and a stated fact (Melbourne 4.35 vs Sydney 0.51), across all phrasings including negation; with no guess both models behave alike. A reads question entities instead. Weights: the retrieval heads' OV copying is identical in A and B, so the fine-tune changed where they look. L0H2's exact RoPE QK raises the preceding-' is' key score in B (99.9th percentile). Weight changes in L5H3.O, L7H3.O, L8H0.O, MLP9-11, L10H0/H2.O and L11H2/H3.O are 2-7x enriched in the K/Q subspaces read by the next retrieval layers, forming a chain from L5 to L12. MLP changes concern country/number answer entities, with no sign recoverable.
